intro: The attached image shows the MASCOT and the exact art style of this series (flat 2D vector, Kurzgesagt-like). We will make a set of separate illustration assets for ONE animated explainer video about the psychology of procrastination in this conversation. Each message asks for exactly ONE image. Keep exactly the same style, line weight, palette and the same mascot as the attached reference in every image.
invariants: STYLE for every image: flat 2D vector illustration, modern minimalist editorial infographic style (like Kurzgesagt), clean geometric shapes, crisp edges, subtle cel-shading, palette: deep navy #0F172A, slate #1E293B, warm amber #F59E0B, coral #F43F5E, off-white #F8FAFC, soft teal #2DD4BF.
steps: H1_desk_hook

Same style and palette as the earlier images (the mascot, if shown, is the same character). A stressed minimalist character sitting at a desk in front of a glowing blank laptop screen, absurdly polishing a desk plant with a tiny cloth while a giant clock ticks in the background, warm amber and coral highlights, high contrast. 16:9 landscape, FULL-BLEED edge to edge, no frame, no border. Solid flat dark navy blue background #0F172A. No text, no letters, no numbers.
